about: Named Shaheed Bhagat Singh Nagar since 2008; ancestral district of the revolutionary Bhagat Singh (village Khatkar Kalan). Carved from Hoshiarpur and Jalandhar in 1995. In the Doaba region.

places.name: Khatkar Kalan
places.location: Khatkar Kalan village, near Banga town
places.facts: Ancestral village of Shaheed Bhagat Singh. Museum holds his half-burnt ashes, blood-soaked sand, blood-stained newspaper the ashes were wrapped in, and an annotated page from the Lahore Conspiracy Case judgment. The family's ancestral haveli stands here.

places.name: Gurdwara Nanaksar, Hakimpur
places.location: Village Hakimpur, Tehsil Banga, 5km south of Bahiram Railway Station
places.facts: Guru Har Rai Sahib Ji rested here traveling from Kartarpur to Kiratpur Sahib; built by Maharaja Ranjit Singh; his elder son was born here.

places.name: Gurdwara Charan Kanwal, Jindowal (Banga)
places.facts: Built by Maharaja Ranjit Singh in memory of Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji, who blessed zamindar Jeeva here after his last battle.

places.name: Gurdwara Gurpalah, Village Sontra
places.facts: Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji is said to have stayed here per Mahan Kosh (description truncated in this scrape session).

howToReach.note: ~92km from Chandigarh; in the Doaba region between the Beas and Sutlej.
